title: The Best Souvenir You Can Take Home from Seville

title: Fotoshooting with Carlos
text:
For the first time in my life I’ve experienced fotoshooting with a professional photographer, Carlos. He explained me how to make professional photos, showed me new parts of the city Sevilla, explained me historical aspects of places we visited. As a result now I have an album of unforgettable photos. 
From now on, Sevilla, I will see it through Carlos' camera.

#Notjustatourist #Laimportanciadelaluz
author: juliaghost
